description: Popup with text-color and background-color swatch sections (including a default/none option), raising OnColorSelected as a text/background pair where one side is set.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Forced layout. Mobile presents the picker as the core sheet.

parameters.name: OnColorSelected
parameters.description: Raised when a color is chosen. Exactly one element of the tuple is non-null: (hex, null) → text color selected; (null, hex) → background color selected. (null, null) → default (remove color) selected for either section.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the picker is dismissed without a selection.

parameters.name: SelectedBgColor
parameters.description: Currently active background-color hex, or null for default.

parameters.name: SelectedTextColor
parameters.description: Currently active text colour as a palette name (gray, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, brown), or null for default. A hex stored before 2.10.0 is mapped to the same name.

notes: Swatches paint from --tm-notion-color-{name} and --tm-notion-color-{name}-bg, never a hex. The accessible name of a swatch is TmNotionColor_{Default|Gray|Brown|Orange|Yellow|Green|Blue|Purple|Pink|Red}.
